In this notebook, I will compile HuProt autoantigen and HLA allele data into a single Excel file. 

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringi)
library(writexl)

selectedparticipants <- c("001-036_T0", "001-038_T0")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# Z Scores

## Hits All

```{r}
huprot.long <- readRDS("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorehits_long.rds")
huprot.long
```

```{r}
huprot.igg.hits <- huprot.long %>% 
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(hits = sum(zscore > 3)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(-Antigen:-ID, -zscore)

huprot.igg.hits
```

## Hits DRB1*15:01

```{r}
igg.zscore.long <- readRDS("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorevalues_long.rds")
igg.zscore.long
```

```{r}
huprot.igg.drb1.exclusive <- igg.zscore.long %>% 
  filter(Antigen %in% c("ENO1", "MED18", "YWHAQ")) %>% 
  select(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response, Antigen, zscore) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Antigen, values_from = zscore)

huprot.igg.drb1.exclusive
```


```{r}
igg.zscore.wide <- read_csv("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorehits_wide.csv")
igg.zscore.wide
```


```{r}
igg.1501.order <- igg.zscore.wide %>% 
  filter(`001-036_T0` > 0 & `001-038_T0` > 0) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(-Antigen:-ID), names_to = "visit", values_to = "zscore") %>% 
  filter(zscore > 0) %>%
  group_by(Antigen) %>% 
  mutate(distinct_biopsies = n_distinct(visit), .after = ID) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(distinct_biopsies, Antigen)

igg.1501.order
```

```{r}
igg.1501.out <- igg.zscore.wide %>% 
  filter(`001-036_T0` > 0 & `001-038_T0` > 0) %>% 
  left_join(igg.1501.order %>% 
              distinct(ID, distinct_biopsies),
            by = "ID") %>% 
  relocate(distinct_biopsies, .after = ID) %>% 
  arrange(distinct_biopsies, ID)

igg.1501.out
```


```{r}
igg.zscore.1501 <- igg.1501.out %>% 
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_remove(., "_T0")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Antigen:distinct_biopsies), names_to = "participant_id", values_to = "zscore") %>% 
  group_by(Antigen, participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(zscore.mean = mean(zscore), .after = zscore) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  distinct(Antigen, participant_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(Antigen, participant_id, zscore.mean) %>%
  arrange(Antigen) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Antigen, names_from = participant_id, values_from = zscore.mean) %>% 
  mutate(Antigen = fct_relevel(Antigen, igg.1501.order %>% distinct(Antigen) %>% pull(Antigen))) %>% 
  arrange(Antigen)

igg.zscore.1501
```

# Combine Lists

```{r}
huprot.out <- list(
  "Key" = data.frame(),
  "Hits By Group" = huprot.igg.hits,
  "UC HLA-DRB1 1501 Exclusive" = huprot.igg.drb1.exclusive,
  "UC HLA-DRB1 1501 Hits" = igg.zscore.1501
)
  

huprot.out
```


# Read Data

```{r}
metadata <- readRDS("data/metadata/241120__predictCOL_metadata_COL_GEX.rds")
metadata
```

```{r}
hla.paths <- list.files("out/hla/allele_assigned", full.names = T)
hla.paths

hla.paths <- hla.paths[str_detect(hla.paths, "Combined", negate = T)]
hla.paths
```

```{r}
hla.names <- str_split(hla.paths, "__", simplify = T)[,2] %>% str_remove(".csv") %>% str_replace("_", "-")
hla.names
```


```{r}
hla.list <- lapply(hla.paths, function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

names(hla.list) <- hla.names
hla.list
```

Subset to only participants in the colon study

```{r}
hla.predictCOL <- lapply(hla.list, function(x) {
  x %>% 
    filter(participant_id %in% metadata$participant_id) %>% 
    left_join(., metadata %>% distinct(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response)) %>% 
    relocate(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response, Allele1, Allele2)
  })

hla.predictCOL
```
# HLA-DRB1

## Wide Matrix

```{r}
hla.drb1.out <- rbind(
  hla.predictCOL$`HLA-DRB1` %>% select(-Allele2) %>%  rename(Allele = Allele1),
  hla.predictCOL$`HLA-DRB1` %>% select(-Allele1) %>% rename(Allele = Allele2)
) %>% 
  arrange(participant_id) %>%
  count(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response, Allele) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Allele,
              values_from = n, 
              values_fill = list(n = 0)) %>% 
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_remove(., "HLA-DRB1\\*"))

hla.drb1.out$`09:01` <- 0
allele.names <- setdiff(colnames(hla.drb1.out), c("participant_id","diagSub","antitnf_response")) %>% sort

hla.drb1.out <- hla.drb1.out %>% 
  relocate(participant_id:antitnf_response, !!allele.names)

hla.drb1.out
```

# Combine Lists

```{r}
hla.out <- list(
  "HLA-DRB1 Enumerated" = hla.drb1.out
  ) %>% 
  append(hla.predictCOL) 

hla.out
```

# Combine All

```{r}
joint.out <- c(
  huprot.out,
  hla.out
)

joint.out
```


```{r}
write_xlsx(joint.out, 
           path = "out/tables/Supplemental Table 8 - HuProt and HLA.xlsx", 
           col_names = TRUE, 
           format_headers = TRUE, 
)
```
